planets.name: Kepler-102 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-102 with a 7.07-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-102 c was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around Kepler-102. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
